final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
